composition_subtypes.role: Sort the stick lengths to enable efficient greedy selection
Alternately pick largest for x and smallest for y using two pointers

payload.core_composition_summary: First sort lengths, then greedily alternate picking from both ends to maximize endpoint distance.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts array then uses two-pointer technique (pop max and min) to maximize sum of squares. This combines sorting and greedy two-pointer mechanics.
